jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.jd_full:
ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

 

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

 

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

 

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work. Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

 

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes
jobs.jd_full:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes teams⭐

We are recruiting a Senior Manager to join our FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes team, whilst supporting our Supplier Performance function. Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area.

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.


🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

  • Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.
  • Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.
  • Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.
  • Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.
  • Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.
  • Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.
  • Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.
  • You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.
  • You have a proven track record of leading through others and can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.
  • You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.
  • You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)
  • Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-CB4

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Applications Engineering Manager (West Coast)
jobs.jd_full:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is building the next generation of industrial robots -- hardware that's powerful, affordable, and designed to scale. We're the largest U.S. industrial robotics company by robots shipped, and our robots are showing up on factory floors everywhere from independent machine shops to NASA and Lockheed Martin. Someone has to make sure those robots actually work -- and someone has to build the team that makes that happen at scale. That's this role.

Note: This position is technically remote, but is territory based and requires you to live on the West Coast. This role also requires up to 25% domestic travel. You're still in the field -- just not living out of a suitcase 2-3 days a week.

Also note: Like every Applications Engineer at Standard Bots, this is not a software engineering role. You are a hands-on industrial automation engineer who also happens to lead people. If you've never commissioned a robotic cell, this isn't the right seat.

The Role

The Applications Engineering Manager is a player-coach. You still know your way around a factory floor -- fixtures, I/O, ladder logic, robot programming, all the things -- and you use that expertise every day, both to stay sharp and to earn the respect of the team you're leading.

You'll manage a team of Applications Engineers across your territory, owning their development, their workload, and the quality of every customer engagement they touch. You'll be the escalation point when installs get complicated, the person who jumps on a plane when a customer situation needs senior eyes, and the one who sets the standard for what great applications engineering looks like at Standard Bots.

This is still a hands-on role. You're not managing from a desk. You're leading from the front.

You'll report directly to the VP of Applications Engineering.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

- Manage and develop a team of Applications Engineers across your territory -- setting expectations, coaching on technical and customer-facing skills, and building a team that executes at a high level

- Own capacity planning and workload distribution across your team -- making sure the right engineer is on the right job and nobody is drowning

- Be the technical and cultural standard-setter for your team; the bar you hold yourself to is the bar your team rises to

- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning -- you invest in your people's growth, not just their output

Territory & Customer Ownership

- Own the applications engineering function for your territory -- from pre-sales POC support through post-install customer success

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex integrations, difficult customer situations, or installs that aren't going as planned

- Partner closely with your Regional Sales Manager on territory priorities, pipeline, and customer strategy -- you're the technical counterpart to their commercial leadership

- Maintain strong relationships with key customer accounts in your territory; they should know you by name and trust your judgment

Hands-On Technical Work

- Stay sharp and stay in it -- you're still designing solutions, reviewing integrations, commissioning cells, and supporting installs when the situation calls for it

- Lead or co-lead technically complex or strategically important customer engagements yourself

- Review and sign off on solution designs, POCs, and integration plans produced by your team

- Travel to customer sites as needed -- up to 25% domestically -- for escalations, key installs, and customer relationship moments

Standards & Continuous Improvement

- Define and enforce the standard for how applications engineering work gets done in your territory -- documentation, handoffs, commissioning checklists, customer training quality

- Feed territory-level learnings back to the broader applications engineering organization and to product and engineering teams

- Help build the playbooks, templates, and training materials that make every AE on your team better and every deployment more repeatable

What We're Looking For

- The same trifecta as our Applications Engineers -- you're genuinely fluent across mechanical, electrical, and software: PLC programming and ladder logic, pneumatics, DC power systems, robot programming, Python scripting, CAD

- 5+ years of hands-on applications engineering, systems integration, or automation engineering experience -- you've done the field work and done it well

- 2+ years of people management or team lead experience -- you've led engineers, given hard feedback, and helped someone grow

- Strong customer-facing presence -- you can manage a difficult customer conversation, set expectations clearly, and represent Standard Bots credibly at a senior level

- Experience managing a distributed team or territory; you know how to lead people you don't see every day

- Comfort with up to 25% domestic travel for escalations, key customer engagements, and team support

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline -- or equivalent hands-on experience that tells the same story

Nice to Have

- Prior experience with collaborative robots (UR, Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar)

- Background scaling an applications engineering or field engineering function -- you've helped build something, not just inherited it

- Experience with vision systems, force/torque sensing, or custom end-of-arm tooling

- Familiarity with machine tending, palletizing, welding, or assembly automation applications

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $200,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Clinical Supply Management
jobs.jd_full:
About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an anti-IFN-β monoclonal antibody. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit JadeBiosciences.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn.

Role Overview

Jade is developing potentially transformational, disease-modifying therapies for people living with autoimmune diseases. With three biologics programs in the clinic and multiple ongoing studies from Phase I to Phase III, we are seeking an experienced Executive Director, Clinical Supply Management to join our CMC leadership team and make sure every patient in our trials receives the right investigational product, on time.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (Head of CMC), you will own clinical supply strategy, planning and execution for all Jade programs. You will shape and scale the Clinical Supply Management function, growing and mentoring a team of internal employees and contractors, and you will lead a global network of CMOs and logistics partners supporting complex, multi-country and multi-site studies with ambitious timelines and enrollment targets.

This is a high-impact role for a self-starter who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work closely with Clinical Operations and Clinical Development to secure supply for every planned study, help prepare the supply chain for BLA filing, launch and commercial readiness, and contribute directly to Jade’s key corporate goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and build the function: Provide strategic and operational leadership for Jade’s Clinical Supply Management function. Further develop and scale the team through a combination of internal headcount and external partners, including recruiting, onboarding and mentoring team members and consultants. Develop robust business processes and SOP in close collaboration with the Quality function.
  • Define the clinical supply strategy: Develop and implement the clinical supply strategy for all Jade programs, from early-stage (Phase 1/2) through late-stage (Phase 3) development, with a forward-looking view toward BLA filing, product launch and commercial readiness.
  • Plan demand and supply: Build and maintain integrated global demand forecasts and supply plans based on protocols, enrollment projections and site activation plans. Balance drug product availability, shelf life, overage and cost, and update plans as studies evolve. Advise on potential risk and challenges to Senior Management and peer groups such as Clinical Operations and Development.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Clinical Operations and Clinical Development on study-specific supply strategies, and with Quality, Regulatory Affairs and CMC to forecast, align and continuously update supply requirements for ongoing and future studies. Develop options and recommendations for stakeholders and senior management.
  • Select and manage CMOs and suppliers: Select, contract and manage clinical supply CMOs, depots, couriers, logistics providers, and other critical suppliers. Set clear performance expectations and KPIs, and build strong partnerships that ensure quality, reliability and cost-effective supply.
  • Oversee clinical supply operations: Direct labeling, packaging, blinding, cold-chain storage and global distribution for all drug product formats, including vials, pre-filled syringes and autoinjectors. Manage comparator sourcing, expiry extensions, relabeling, returns, reconciliation and destruction.
  • Manage IRT and inventory: Define supply requirements for IRT/IxRS systems, including resupply strategies and user acceptance testing, and monitor inventory at depots and sites to prevent stock-outs and minimize waste.
  • Ensure compliance and quality: Maintain full compliance with Jade SOPs, cGMP, GDP, GCP, ICH guidelines and applicable global regulatory and import/export requirements. Partner with Quality on batch release (including QP release for EU studies), deviations and change controls, keep the function inspection-ready, and contribute to regulatory submissions (IND, IMPD, CTA).
  • Own the budget and reporting: Manage the clinical supply budget, and report regularly and concisely to stakeholders and senior management on inventory, supply and demand, changes and risks across all programs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering or a related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in clinical supply chain management, ideally with biologics, including significant experience leading teams. Experience in commercial supply chain management is a plus.
  • Proven experience managing clinical supply for biologics in vials within cold-chain environments, using local and multinational CMOs; experience with pre-filled syringes and combination products such as autoinjectors highly preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple early- and late-stage programs, including multi-country Phase 3 studies and bridging studies for biologic combination products.
  • Comprehensive understanding of global regulatory and import/export requirements across Europe, North America, China, Japan and Rest of World (ROW), and strong working knowledge of cGMP, GDP and GCP.
  • Hands-on experience with IRT/IxRS systems, clinical supply forecasting tools and budget management.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling clinical supply functions, including hiring, onboarding and managing team members and consultants to meet critical milestones.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership and interpersonal skills, with a track record of aligning CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Clinical teams and building trusting relationships with external CMO partners.
  • A strategic thinker with a proven execution record, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a complex, fast-paced clinical development environment.

Position Location

This is a remote role; periodic travel to team and company events is required.

The anticipated salary range for candidates for this role is $280,000 - $300,000. The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but not limited to, relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography.

As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the United States, Jade Bioscience participates in E-Verify. To learn more about E-Verify please review this poster.

Jade Biosciences is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Development Outsourcing
jobs.jd_full:
About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an anti-IFN-β monoclonal antibody. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit JadeBiosciences.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn.

Role Overview

As the Associate Director of Development Outsourcing, you will play a key role in supporting the sourcing and strategic management of Jade's external vendors. This role will partner closely with Development Operations and study teams to support vendor sourcing, contracting, governance, and the development of strong vendor relationships across clinical development programs from Phase I through Phase IV.

The successful candidate will work cross-functionally to drive effective execution, support issue resolution, and contribute to continuous improvement of Development Outsourcing processes. This newly created role will report to the Director, Development outsourcing. This is a fully remote role and will require occasional travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary Development Outsourcing lead for assigned studies and programs, partnering closely with cross-functional study teams and external vendors to ensure successful execution of outsourcing activities.
  • Implement outsourcing strategies and plans established by Development Outsourcing leadership while independently managing day-to-day vendor-related activities for assigned studies.
  • Provide outsourcing expertise and recommendations to study teams regarding vendor selection, contract strategy, oversight, and issue resolution.
  • Ensure outsourcing deliverables, timelines, and decisions are executed efficiently and aligned with study objectives.
  • Lead vendor sourcing and evaluation activities in support of Development Programs, including preparation of RFI/RFP materials, proposal review, bid defense coordination, comparative analyses, and recommendation development.
  • Lead the development, negotiation, and execution of vendor agreements, including Confidentiality Agreements, Master Service Agreements, Statements of Work, Change Orders, rate cards, Letters of Intent, and other vendor-related agreements.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and study teams to drive contract execution and resolve business or operational issues impacting study startup or execution.
  • Act as the day-to-day outsourcing representative for assigned vendors and studies, proactively identifying and resolving operational issues, risks, and decisions.
  • Escalate significant risks, relationship concerns, performance issues, or strategic decisions to Development Outsourcing leadership while driving follow-through on agreed actions.
  • Support vendor governance activities by preparing materials, tracking actions, monitoring performance metrics, and ensuring commitments are executed.
  • Monitor vendor performance and support implementation of corrective and preventive actions when needed.
  • Partner closely with Development Operations, Clinical Quality Assurance, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure effective vendor oversight and execution.
  • Support vendor qualification, audit readiness, inspection preparedness, and oversight activities in collaboration with Clinical Quality Assurance.
  • Maintain documentation related to vendor selection, contracting, governance, performance management, and issue resolution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Development Outsourcing processes, tools, templates, and best practices.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment by balancing urgent issues, strategic priorities, and routine responsibilities across multiple concurrent activities.
  • Exercise sound judgment and independent decision-making when addressing operational challenges, while recognizing when leadership engagement or escalation is required.
  • Demonstrate initiative and accountability by driving decisions, resolving obstacles, and ensuring commitments are completed.

Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, or contract research experience with significant experience in Development Outsourcing, Clinical Operations, Vendor Management, or a related function.
  • Strong understanding of clinical development and outsourced service delivery models across Phases I-IV.
  • Demonstrated experience leading vendor sourcing initiatives, RFP processes, bid defenses, contract negotiations, and vendor oversight activities.
  • Experience negotiating and managing Master Service Agreements, Statements of Work, Change Orders, and other vendor-related contracts.
  • Proven ability to independently manage complex outsourcing activities across multiple studies and stakeholders.
  • Strong business judgment, organizational skills, and ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to identify risks, make timely decisions, and drive resolution of issues with limited direction.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, influence, and relationship management skills.
  • Experience collaborating effectively within cross-functional and matrixed organizations.

Position Location

This is a remote role; periodic travel to team and company events is required.

The anticipated salary range for candidates for this role is $175,000 - $190,000. The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but not limited to, relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography.

As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the United States, Jade Bioscience participates in E-Verify. To learn more about E-Verify please review this poster.

Jade Biosciences is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Assistant Site Manager - Events (Bristol)
jobs.jd_full:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Assistant Site Manager - VR Concept Venue

Location: Bristol
Contract: Freelance, September 2026 – March 2027 (potential to extend)
Pay: £16 per hour
Working Pattern: Full-time (job share considered); requires evenings, weekends, and public holiday availability. Shift pattern arranged to overlap with, and to cover for, the Event Manager (Site Manager) as needed.
Reports to: Charlotte Potter, Producer – Fever (day-to-day line management from the Event Manager / Site Manager)
Manages: Front-of-house staff (agency and in-house); full management responsibility for all staff, including cleaners and front-of-house teams, when covering for the Event Manager during periods of leave

Role Overview
We're looking for a proactive and technically confident Assistant Site Manager to support the day-to-day running of our immersive VR experience in a high-footfall Bristol venue. Working closely with the Event Manager, you'll help keep the visitor experience running smoothly, staff well supported, and systems fully
operational.

This role also acts as key holiday and absence cover for the Event Manager (Site Manager), stepping up to take full responsibility for the venue — technical, operational, and people management — whenever they are away. You'll need the confidence to run the site independently at short notice, alongside your regular assistant duties.

Key Responsibilities

🔧 Technical & Operational Delivery
● Support daily setup and shutdown of the VR experience, ensuring all systems, hardware, and software are fully operational.
● Carry out pre-opening checks (hardware calibration, environment readiness, content testing) alongside or in place of the Event Manager.
● Troubleshoot first-line IT and technical issues on-site (VR headsets, PCs, networking, displays), escalating to tech support partners where needed.
● Monitor experience performance throughout the day, resolving disruptions or resets promptly.
● Maintain stock of consumables (e.g., sanitisation wipes, headset liners) and uphold hygiene protocols.
● Assist in keeping technical documentation up to date and support training of team members on troubleshooting procedures.

🏛 Venue Operations (Ground Floor)
● Help ensure the ground floor VR experience space is clean, safe, and visitor-ready at all times.
● Coordinate cleaning and reactive maintenance for the VR zone, including public and back-of-house areas.
● Support queue management, timed entry, and visitor flow, particularly during peak periods.

👥 Team Support & Holiday Cover
● Assist in line managing front-of-house staff, including agency team members, day to day.
● Support daily staff briefings, rota coordination, and shift cover.
● Model high standards of customer service and professionalism for the wider team.
● Help train new team members on VR-specific procedures, safety, and technical protocols.
● Take full ownership of team management, rotas, and briefings during any period covering for the Event Manager, ensuring continuity of standards and cover.

🛡 Health & Safety
● Support daily safety and cleanliness walkarounds of the VR area.
● Act as a trained first aider for the venue, leading incident response (first aid, equipment malfunctions, or guest complaints), including full responsibility for this when covering for the Event Manager.
● Help keep risk assessments for the VR zone up to date and log incidents or near misses.
● Ensure staff are trained in relevant H&S procedures, including emergency evacuations and manual handling (if required).

📣 Customer Experience
● Help maintain a welcoming, engaging, and inclusive atmosphere for all guests.
● Act as a point of escalation for visitor queries or complaints, and the main escalation point when covering for the Event Manager.
● Support customer feedback mechanisms and feed insights back to the Producer and Event Manager.

📝 Communication & Reporting
● Provide handovers to the Event Manager (or, during cover periods, directly to the Producer) covering technical issues, visitor numbers, and operational highlights.
● Maintain accurate logs: staff attendance, incident reports, daily checklists, and maintenance tickets.
● Ensure a clean handover back to the Event Manager after any period of holiday cover, flagging anything requiring follow-up.

Ideal Candidate Profile
● Current, valid First Aid at Work certification is required for this role.
● Experience in live event, visitor attraction, or venue operations — preferably in immersive or tech-driven environments.
● Working knowledge of VR hardware/software and basic IT troubleshooting (e.g., Windows PCs, networks, Wi-Fi, device calibration).
● Experience supporting or managing teams, including casual/agency staff, in high-traffic public settings.
● Comfortable stepping up to run a site independently at short notice, with strong organisational skills and a calm, solutions-focused approach under pressure.
● Confident communicator and team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
● Working knowledge of health & safety regulations and customer service best practices.

Additional Info
● Flexibility is essential: early starts, late finishes, and public holidays are part of the standard schedule.
● Some Mondays/Tuesdays may be required for maintenance, special events, or staff training.
● Holiday cover for the Event Manager should be expected on a periodic basis throughout the contract; specific dates to be agreed and scheduled in advance where possible.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. jobs.title: Product Manager-Data Quality
jobs.jd_full:
About Innovative Systems
Innovative Systems builds enterprise data quality, address validation, and AML compliance software for Fortune 1000 firms worldwide. Founded in 1968, we are known for fast, accurate, and scalable solutions delivered through our Enlighten, PostLocate, and FinScan brands. We have regional offices in London, Mexico City, Dubai, and São Paulo, and we have been recognized as a Top Workplace.

The Role
We are hiring an experienced Product Manager to own our data quality portfolio: the Enlighten Data Quality Suite, PostLocate global address validation and geocoding and FinScan™ data-driven compliance products. These products sit underneath some of the largest customer data environments in banking, insurance, retail, and government, and they also power the matching engine behind FinScan. You will also help grow the FinScan portfolio with new DQ-powered compliance products: Validate, Verify, UBO, and KYB.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has shipped data products before and writes requirements engineers actually want to build from. You will turn customer problems into crisp specs, make the call on tradeoffs, and see features through to adoption. If you know the difference between a parse rule and a match rule, have opinions on survivorship, and have lived through a CASS cycle, we want to talk.

What You Will Own

  • Enlighten Data Quality Suite: profiling, cleansing and standardization, match and link (entity resolution), enrichment, and ongoing data monitoring.

  • PostLocate: global address validation, parsing, standardization, and geocoding, including CASS certification and USPS data (DPV, LACSLink, SuiteLink) for the US.

  • Shared DQ engine: the knowledgebases, matching algorithms, and APIs that Enlighten, PostLocate, and FinScan all depend on.

  • FinScan data-driven compliance products: an expanding portfolio of FinScan offerings built on the same DQ stack, extending FinScan beyond screening into identity and entity due diligence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the DQ roadmap end to end, from discovery and prioritization through release, adoption, and iteration.
  • Write clear, testable requirements: PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases for matching, parsing, and address logic.
  • Translate customer data problems (duplicate records, bad addresses, broken golden records, failed migrations) into well-scoped product work.
  • Interview customers, data stewards, and implementation teams; map their workflows, requirements and validate problems before committing engineering time.
  • Partner closely with engineering and QA on design, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release readiness.
  • Manage the reference data lifecycle for PostLocate, including postal data updates, country coverage, and certification timelines.
  • Drive modernization of the suite: cloud and API delivery, real-time services, and AI-assisted matching and cleansing.
  • Define and track product KPIs such as match accuracy, false match and missed match rates, address validation rates, throughput, latency, and customer adoption.
  • Work with sales, marketing, and services on positioning, pricing input, launch readiness, demos, and enablement.
  • Track the DQ, MDM, and address verification markets and turn what you learn into product decisions and strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent experience
  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years on data quality, MDM, entity resolution, address validation, or data integration products.
  • Proven track record writing detailed requirements and user stories that engineering teams build from with minimal back and forth.
  • Working knowledge of core DQ concepts: profiling, parsing, standardization, fuzzy and probabilistic matching, deduplication, householding, and survivorship or golden record logic.
  • Familiarity with address validation and geocoding, including USPS CASS, DPV, and international postal data.
  • Strong communication skills with technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
  • Up to 10% travel for customer visits and conferences.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-volume batch and real-time API products, including mainframe or on-premise to cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to AI or ML in matching, entity resolution, or data cleansing workflows.
  • Background in financial services, insurance, or other regulated industries where data quality feeds KYC, AML, or reporting.
  • Experience working with external data providers such as postal authorities or reference data vendors.
  • Data management credentials such as CDMP, or USPS address quality training.

Location
Based in our World Headquarters, located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania with the ability to work a hybrid schedule of 2 days a week at the office. If not based in Pittsburgh, we would also consider remote work options for candidates living in the following areas: Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Washington D.C.

Work visa sponsorship is not available. Innovative Systems does not accept unsolicited resumes. Innovative Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM) to own the supply chain execution of our new product introductions (NPI) for devices and accessories, from concept through mass production. You will be the connective tissue between Product, Hardware Engineering, Operations, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and Logistics, driving cross-functional alignment on schedule, cost, and supply readiness for complete systems rather than individual commodities.

You will lead through influence. You’ll set and support program rhythms, surface risks early, drive decisions across teams with competing priorities, and lead Engineering designs that can be built, sourced, and shipped at scale. We also want someone who treats recurring program work (status reporting, risk tracking, readiness checks, data pulls) as something to automate. You’ll build and use AI agents and workflow automation to free up time for the judgment-heavy work that moves programs forward.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

Mastermind and power NPI programs end-to-end

  • Champion next-generation device and accessory programs from bold concept stages through EVT, DVT, PVT, explosive ramp, and full mass production, taking full ownership of the end-to-end supply chain master plan
  • Drive flawless launch readiness in close lockstep with world-class JDM partners and internal operations engines, optimizing BOM+MVA, mastering development E&O, mitigating risk, and executing aggressive ramp curves
  • Command program-level cost, precision scheduling, and strategic risk, pitching clear, high-impact decisions and trade-offs to executive leadership
  • Establish and enforce rigorous build-readiness criteria and high-stakes gate reviews at every critical phase—covering materials, custom packaging, and global logistics
  • Engineer lead-time-driven backward-scheduling from OK2MP through demanding REL/CRT testing to secure critical PO release deadlines with total precision
  • Strategically classify process paths early (Full PLCM vs. Legacy Fast-Track exception) and drive ironclad stage-gate documentation from day-one kickoff

Galvanize cross-functional alignment and exert high-impact influence

  • Serve as the indispensable single point of accountability and catalyst for supply chain excellence across Product, Engineering, Operations, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Marketing
  • Unify diverse stakeholders around top priorities, resolve friction with agility, and guide executive decisions with compelling options and bold recommendations
  • Partner dynamically with Hardware Engineering on DFM, design-for-cost, and proactive supply-chain risk mitigation right at the drawing board
  • Lead high-octane schedule stewardship, synchronizing supply roadmaps directly to the stage-gate timeline and orchestrating high-alignment weekly core-team reviews
  • Run dynamic program cadences (core team syncs, readiness reviews, executive updates) that catalyze action and drive transformative momentum
  • Orchestrate seamless, structured handoffs to sustaining Supply Chain Managers post-MP ramp, ensuring long-term operational success and flawless execution

Neutralize supply risks and drive world-class partner performance

  • Join forces with Sourcing, Planning, and global manufacturing leaders to guarantee resilient supply lines, crush long-lead bottlenecks, and deploy bulletproof contingency strategies
  • Power Sourcing initiatives with aggressive cost targets, actionable should-cost insights, and high-stakes supplier negotiations across complex system BOMs
  • Relentlessly hunt down and resolve capacity, supply, quality, or logistics bottlenecks before they ever threaten the critical path
  • Spearhead the strategic Materials Risk Buy approval workflow, evaluating financial exposure and securing rapid executive alignment
  • Manage high-impact engineering changes with precision, driving seamless inventory disposition and cutover plans
  • Oversee NPI Material Spend and NMS budgets with absolute fiscal rigor across tooling, NRE, and ORT investments

Revolutionize supply chain operations with cutting-edge AI and automation

  • Architect high-leverage playbooks, intelligent workflows, and custom tooling that supercharge productivity across the entire global supply chain organization
  • Transform complex data into game-changing insights through futuristic dashboards, predictive risk analytics, and compelling executive briefings
  • Pioneer autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to handle routine program tasks, status roll-ups, and data pulls, freeing your bandwidth for high-value strategic leadership
  • Champion emerging AI advancements and translate state-of-the-art tech into transformative, real-world operational advantages
  • Maintain hyper-accurate, modernized supply chain tracking infrastructure across ERP/PLM platforms, PR/PO tracking, and program dashboards

Embody and lead as an inspirational Samsara leader

  • Embody and champion Samsara’s core cultural ethos—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—inspiring everyone around you to achieve extraordinary results

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years of experience in supply chain program management, NPI, or operations for hardware or electronics products, with a track record of taking products from concept to mass production
  • BS in a relevant field (Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain) or equivalent practical experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority
  • Strong understanding of the NPI lifecycle and builds (EVT, DVT, PVT), BOM and ECO management, and CM and JDM operations
  • Experience working with international manufacturing and supply partners at executive levels
  • Advanced analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insights and craft clear executive presentations
  • Strong organizational skills: prioritization, attention to detail, and triage of complicated issues
  • Self-motivated, proactive problem solver who is comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools, agents, or automation (for example LLM-based workflows, scripting, or low-code tools) to streamline recurring work, or a demonstrated passion for learning to do so

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with IoT, telematics, or connected hardware, including accessories, cables, and sensors
  • Experience with ERP, PLM, and planning systems (for example NetSuite) and SQL or Python for data analysis
  • Experience building internal tools or agents that other team members adopt
  • PMP or equivalent program management certification

$97,282.50—$147,150 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:

XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501©3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all.  Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de-risk early-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real-world scale.

We operate across 5 areas of impact, including: 

  • Deep Tech + Exploration
  • Energy + Climate + Nature
  • Food + Water + Waste
  • Health
  • Learning + Society

Join XPRIZE to help create meaningful impact as we strive to empower humanity to achieve breakthroughs and architect a more equitable and abundant future for all.

Position Description 

We’re looking for a Marketing Program Manager to develop and manage comprehensive marketing campaigns for key initiatives and programs within the organization. This person will work closely with the Marketing and Prize Operations teams to plan, develop, activate, and manage marketing activities to drive awareness and engagement with key audiences. This role serves as the primary marketing point of contact for Prize Operations teams and is a pivotal role for the success of XPRIZE competitions. 

Responsibilities

  • Marketing Campaign Strategy: Partner with other marketing and Prize Operations teams to develop integrated campaigns that build awareness and engagement for prizes, programs, and the foundation. Define measurable objectives, target audience, and associated calls to action for each campaign; and provide regular reporting to stakeholders tracking progress and performance against objectives.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build and nurture relationships with internal and external stakeholders across programs, including prize/program teams, sponsors, partners, judges, and advisors. Navigate competing stakeholder priorities to ensure that marketing campaigns are aligned with prize objectives and business priorities. Provide marketing-specific prize and program updates to stakeholders.
  • Project Management: Leverage project management skills and the PM tool of record to ensure that event and campaign deliverables are completed in a timely manner, and all stakeholders are updated on progress, risks, and challenges.
  • Communications: In partnership with the Communications and Creative teams, contribute to the development of key messaging for programs and prize-related content, as well as communications resources for external stakeholders.
  • Events: In partnership with the Experiential team, contribute to the planning and execution of events to support campaign objectives. Develop marketing materials to support foundation, program, and prize milestone events. Collaborate with Prize Operations teams to develop materials to support XPRIZE presence at industry conferences and events.
  • Budgeting and Resource Management: Support the development and management of prize marketing budgets, including classifying actuals and tracking actuals against budget and forecast.
  • Marketing Technology: Leverage marketing-specific tools and technology to manage marketing campaigns and associated projects; measure campaign performance; develop and refine target audiences; and gather social media insights.
  • Trendspotting: Stay up-to-date on prize/program-related news and industry trends, proactively identifying opportunities to incorporate trends into active and upcoming campaigns.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of proven experience developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that unify messaging across a variety of channels
  • 4-year college or university degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms
  • The ability to combine technical/scientific information with emotion to form a compelling message across multiple audiences
  • Experience in developing cross-channel marketing campaigns consisting of clear, measurable objectives, well-defined target audience(s), and associated calls to action
  • Experience monitoring campaign performance, gathering data insights, and preparing reports to evaluate campaign efficiency, proposing changes to optimize campaigns as needed
  • Strong organizational and project management skills to handle multiple tasks, manage campaigns from development to launch, and ensure timely delivery of campaign deliverables
  • Experience with creating and managing budgets, including budget tracking and reporting
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive collaboration across teams to maximize impact and drive business results
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to influence without authority, manage competing priorities, address concerns, and work closely and collaboratively with colleagues and staff
  • Passion for the mission of XPRIZE and the work we are doing to build a better future
  • Having a growth mindset and a passion for continuous improvement is essential

Why Work at XPRIZE:

  • Remote-first environment (must live and work in the United States)
